datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments across Madagascar to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data representing IPC phase classifications were compiled into monthly spatial datasets for 2020, capturing food security status across administrative units.

sources.name: FEWS NET
sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys to assess acute food insecurity severity and geographic extent.
